events.name: Build your AI Organization Workshop
events.description:
Learn how to create AI agents that can help with real business tasks. In this hands-on workshop, you will explore how AI can automate workflows, support teams, and improve daily operations. Use Kylon to create agents and Nebius for cloud compute.

You will see real examples, build your own AI agent with guidance from the Kylon team, and learn how to use AI for practical business use cases.

No advanced AI experience is needed — just bring your laptop and ideas for tasks you want to automate.
events.location: Homebrew Club, 111 Maiden Ln #540, San Francisco, CA 94108

events.name: Prompt to Production: AI Builders, Secure Code and Skills Workshop
events.description:
Learn how to take an idea from a simple prompt to a working application using AI. This hands-on workshop covers the complete AI development process — building applications, securing AI-generated code, and publishing reusable AI skills.

You will use AI tools to create an application, test and improve its security, and turn parts of your project into tools that other AI agents can use.

You will build an application from a single prompt using AI, learn how AI can plan, code, test, and improve projects, identify and fix security issues in AI-generated code, publish your work as reusable AI Skills, explore how modern AI workflows are changing software development.

Perfect for developers, builders, and anyone interested in creating applications with AI.
events.location: Homebrew Club, 111 Maiden Ln #540, San Francisco, CA 94108

events.name: Design & Deploy Workshop
events.description:
Turn your idea into a working product using AI. In this hands-on workshop, you will learn how to design, build, and deploy a modern web application using AI-powered development tools.

You will go through the complete process of building a product — from creating ideas and designing interfaces to adding functionality, connecting backend services, and launching your application.

During the workshop, you will use AI tools to create designs, build your application, add features, and deploy a working prototype. You will learn a practical AI-powered workflow that you can use to quickly turn ideas into real products.

This workshop is designed for founders, designers, developers, students, and anyone interested in building with AI. Bring your laptop and an idea, or create one during the session.

events.name: Break my Product 2.0
events.description:
Real users. Tougher testing. Better products.

Built something and want brutally honest feedback before your next launch?

We are back with an improved format designed to help founders uncover hidden issues, validate assumptions, and ship with confidence.

Whether you're building an MVP, AI product, startup, side project, or prototype, this session gives you direct access to thoughtful testers who aren't afraid to ask hard questions.

How it works:

Bring a product, prototype, MVP, or side project.
Get matched with fellow founders, builders, designers, and creators.
Watch as they explore, test, question, and intentionally try to break your product.
Receive candid, actionable feedback on usability, onboarding, messaging, UX, positioning, and overall product experience.
Return the favor by testing someone else's product and sharing your own insights.

This isn't a demo day—it's a collaborative product stress test.

You'll leave with:

Fresh perspectives from real users.
A clearer understanding of where people get stuck.
Actionable improvements you can implement immediately.
New connections with builders who care about creating better products.

Whether you're validating an idea, polishing an MVP, preparing for launch, or iterating after your first release, this is your chance to discover what works, what doesn't, and what to fix next.
events.location: Homebrew Club, 111 Maiden Ln #540, San Francisco, CA 94108
